purpose: Standardize God Mode handoff before validation, commit, push, PR, or release claims.

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: God Mode adds visible dashboard surfaces, source-controlled contracts, governance docs, quality gates, telemetry, ADR workflow, validation plan, release readiness, and work package tracking.

sections.title: Changed Surfaces
sections.content: Product surface, Command Center feature growth, goals, repos, docs, agents, security and AI readiness, validation, architecture decisions, and handoff have dedicated artifacts.

sections.title: Validation Status
sections.content: Core God Mode validation commands, full quality:governance, and local headless Chrome runtime verification have run and passed. Remaining blockers are commit boundary review and push/CI evidence.

sections.title: Risks
sections.content: Primary risks are commit staging not yet finalized, unpushed branch state, missing CI pass evidence, and unrelated user work that must not be overwritten.

sections.title: Rollback
sections.content: Rollback must remove the relevant bounded slice: dashboard panels, contracts, docs, checkers, package scripts, telemetry, and governance index entries.

sections.title: Next Commands
sections.content: Run the handoff check, validation plan check, work package check, ADR workflow check, completion audit check, run-state check, staging manifest check, changelog check, feature growth ledger check, and full quality governance before commit or push.

sections.title: Protected User Work
sections.content: Unrelated user or system changes must be preserved during validation, commit preparation, and push handoff.

completionRule: A handoff is complete only when validation status, risks, rollback, next commands, and protected user work are explicit and current.
